chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Abbas, from al-Hasan ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
I said to him, 'Some of our companions fabricate (hadith) and throw (accusations) against those who oppose them.' So he said to me, 'Refraining from them is more beautiful.'
Then he said, 'By Allah, O Abu Hamza! The people, all of them, are the children of the transgressors (adultery) except for our Shites.'
I said, 'How can there be a way out for me from this?' So he said to me, 'O Abu Hamza! The Revealed Book of Allah indicates it.'
Surely Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, made for us, the People of the Household, three portions in all of the spoils of war (al-fay').
And know that whatever you take as spoils of war, lo! a fifth thereof is for Allah, and for the Messenger and for the kinsman (who hath need) and orphans and the needy and the wayfarer.
So we are the owners of the Khums and the spoils of war, and we have made it unlawful for all the people except for our Shites.
By Allah, O Abu Hamza! There is no land which is conquered, and no Khums is applied on anything from it, except that it was unlawful for the one who receives it, whether it be genitals or wealth.

And if the truth were to appear, the man would sell himself cheaply to those who do not increase (in status), to the extent that a man from among them would ransom himself with all his wealth and seek salvation for himself, but he would not achieve anything from that.
And they have taken us and our Shites out from our right without an excuse, or right, or proof.
I said, 'His statement, the Mighty and Majestic: Do you await for us but one of two most excellent things?'

He said: 'Either death in obedience to Allah or realization of the appearance of the Imam. And we await them, along with what we are in of hardship, that Allah will afflict them with punishment from Himself.'
He said: 'It is metamorphosis (al-maskh) or by our hands, and it is the killing.'
Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said to His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family): Say, 'Wait; we too will wait with you.'
And waiting (tarabbus) is the anticipation of the occurrence of affliction upon their enemies.

key_terms.إِدْرَاكُ ظُهُورِ إِمَامٍ: Realization of the appearance of the Imam

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Khums for the Ahl al-Bayt according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) asserts the exclusive right of the Ahl al-Bayt and their Shias to the 'Khums' of war spoils, citing Surah Al-Anfal 8:41 to distinguish their share from the general populace. He further elaborates on the concept of 'Tarrabbus' (waiting for affliction), linking the Shia's patient endurance of hardship to the divine promise of either martyrdom in obedience or the emergence of the Imam, while awaiting Allah's punishment upon their enemies.

en.hubeali: H 14879 – Ali Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al-Abbas, from Al-Hassan Bin Abdul Rahmaan, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Abu Hamza, who has narrated the following:
I asked Abu Ja’farasws that, ‘Some of our companions are fabricating (Hadeeth) and throwing them against the ones who oppose them’. So heasws said to me: ‘Refraining from them is more beautiful’.
Then said: ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, O Abu Hamza! The people, all of them, are the children of the transgressors (adultery) except for our<sup>asws</sup> Shites’.
I said, ‘How can there be a way out for me, from this?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘The Revealed Book of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Evidences against them.
Surely, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Made for us<sup>asws</sup> the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Household three portions in the whole of the spoils of war (Al-Fey).

Then Allahazwj Said: “[8:41] And know that whatever you take as spoils of war, lo! a fifth thereof is for Allah, and for the messenger and for the kinsman (who hath need) and orphans and the needy and the wayfarer”.
So we<sup>asws</sup> are the owners of Al-Khums (the fifth), and the spoils of war (Al-Fey), and it has been Made unlawful to all the people except for our<sup>asws</sup> Shites.

By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, O Abu Hamza! There is no land which has been conquered, and no fifth (Khums) has been applied on anything from it except that it was unlawful for the one who received it for his genitals or assets.

And if the truth were to appear (Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup>) the man would be desperate to sell himself cheaply to the extent that the man from among them would be prepare to ransom himself with all of his wealth, and seek the salvation for himself. So he will not achieve anything from that.
And they have taken us<sup>asws</sup> and our<sup>asws</sup> Shites out from those rights of ours without an excuse, or right, or proof’.
I said, ‘The Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: “[9:52] Say: Do you await for us but one of two most excellent things?”
Heasws said: ‘But it is death in obedience to Allahazwj or realisation of the appearance of Imamasws (Al-Qaimasws, And we await for you that Allah will afflict you with punishment from Himself
and it is metamorphosis or by our hands and it is the killing.
Allahazwj Said to Hisazwj Prophetsaww: “So wait; we too will wait with you”.
And the waiting is for the occurrence of the affliction upon their<sup>asws</sup> enemies’.
en.sarwar: And by the above chain (of narrators), who has narrated the following: Abu Ja’far (a.s.) regarding the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: “[38:86] Say: “No reward do I ask of you for this nor am I a pretender [38:87] It is nothing but a reminder to the nations”. He (a.s.) said: ‘It (the Reminder) is Amir-ul- Momineen (a.s.)’.
“[38:88] And most certainly you will come to know about it after a time”.
He (a.s.) said: ‘During the coming out of Al-Qaim (a.s.)’.

And with regards to the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic “[11:110] We certainly gave the Book to Moses, but differences arose therein”. He (a.s.) said: ‘They differed just like this community has differed regarding the Book, and they will be differing with regards to the Book with Al-Qaim (a.s.) which he (a.s.) will be coming to them with, to the extent that numerous people would deny it. So he (a.s.) will march against them and strike their necks. And as for the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: “[42:21] And but for a decisive word it would have been judged between them. Lo! for wrong-doers is a painful Punishment”. Had it not been for what had preceded among them from Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic, Al-Qaim (a.s.) would not let remain any one among them’. And with regards to the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: “[70:26] And those who accept the truth of the Judgement day”, he (a.s.) said: ‘The coming out of Al-Qaim (a.s.)’. And the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: “[6:23] By Allah, our Lord, we were not polytheists”, he (a.s.) said: ‘It means the Wilayah of Ali (a.s.) ‘. And with regards to the Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: “[17:81] And say: The truth has come and the falsehood has vanished; surely falsehood is a vanishing (thing)”, he (a.s.) said: ‘When Al-Qaim (a.s.) makes the stand the governments of the falsehood will be destroyed’.
